question: What is an advantage of NFS as compared to Fibre Channel?
options: NFS removes the impact of IP overhead.
NFS enables thin provisioning for LUNs.
NFS provides direct access to the underlying storage hardware.
NFS provides the dynamic allocation of storage capacity.
theory: Because NFS storage is presented as file-system-level network shares rather than raw block LUNs, capacity on an NFS-backed datastore can be grown or shrunk dynamically at the storage layer without the LUN resizing, rescan, and filesystem-extend steps that Fibre Channel block storage requires - this dynamic, thin-friendly allocation of capacity is the practical advantage NFS offers over FCP in virtualized environments. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 10 - NFS Concepts)
